mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns fail to exceed baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS < 1%, or the rate remains above 1% for > 6 months without subsequent return acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, raising inflation expectations and compressing corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 4.5%, or the rate remains below 4.5% for > 3 months without prior return reversal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns fail to rise when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase simultaneously, or the correlation between proxies is < 0.7 in a 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals higher policy rates, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 2% during the tightening cycle, or the rate increase is not part of a sustained tightening pattern.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment (PAYEMS) below 140,000 signals a strengthening labor market, boosting productivity and corporate investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 140,000 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative despite PAYEMS dropping below 140,000, or the rate remains above 140,000 for > 6 months without return acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in economic demand (GDPC1) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1%) creates a dual expansion signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 increases and FEDFUNDS remains below 1% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns fail to rise when both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS conditions are met, or the correlation between proxies is < 0.6 in a 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During an inflationary supply shock regime, simultaneous increases in supply (INDPRO) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) indices signal overproduction and rising costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and CPIAUCSL increase above their 12-month averages in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns remain positive despite both INDPRO and CPIAUCSL rising above thresholds, or the correlation between proxies exceeds 0.8 in a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate below 4% signals a robust labor market, fostering economic growth and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns fail to rise when UNRATE remains below 4% for > 6 months, or the rate exceeds 4% in a subsequent month without return reversal.
